title: Crated with Love Alternatives: 5 Date Night Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for boxes like Crated with Love? Compare five date night boxes that plan the night for two, from cocktail kits and escape puzzles to craft projects.
body_markdown:
The closest match


### DateBox Club vs Crated with Love


**Best for:** Couples who loved having the whole night planned and want the same open-the-box-and-go evening.


[DateBox Club](https://dateboxclub.com/collections/subscription-plans) sends one planned date night a month, rotating between a game night, a deeper-conversation activity, and a craft, with a snack to share in every box.


#### What feels familiar


Everything for the night arrives in one box with step-by-step instructions and a new playlist, and the dates aren’t themed around sex or romance, which suits couples who liked Crated with Love’s family-friendly tone. You can reschedule, pause, or cancel from your account.


#### What changes


It’s the priciest box here, and only some months are games. Others are a conversation or a craft. DateBox Club suggests planning your first date about two weeks after you order and emails a printable date to use while you wait.
